notes: Sheet is rotated: north points to the upper left (about 67 deg CCW from sheet up). Two streets are printed NO NAME: a 25 ft street parallel to and west of Streng (recorded as 'unnamed street (printed NO NAME, west of Streng)'; dead end at the north, opens onto the railroad right of way at the south), and a ~40 ft street running NW from Colerain along the west side of the B&O SW R.R. at the bottom left ('unnamed street (printed NO NAME, along B&O SW R.R.)'). Streng, Top and Erhardt are printed without suffix (STRENG, TOP, ERHARDT) and recorded as Street; the key map spells Erhardt as EHRHARDT. Dodsworth Av. (60') crosses the top-left corner from the left edge to the top edge with no junction on this sheet. A 6 in. water pipe runs from Dodsworth ESE through the Bruckman Brewery grounds to the north end of Streng in a ~35-40 ft strip between property lines; no street name or width is printed for it, so it is not recorded as a street. The open strip between the rear lot lines and the Miami Canal bank (north of Top) is not labelled; Erhardt is labelled only south of Top. Colerain bends only slightly (~2 deg) at the Streng junction / railroad bridge. The A-B dash-dot line at x~6310 is the join with sheet 604.
